concerns.text: Task T010 (verify_datasets.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012 (download.py) to have downloaded data first. A verification task cannot run in parallel with its data source generation; it must strictly follow T012. Marking it [P] creates a false parallel execution path that will fail.

Task T046 (Frozen Critic Model) and T060 (Question Bank) are marked [P] but T014 (Dialogue Generation) explicitly lists them as prerequisites. While T046 and T060 can be implemented in parallel, the [P] tag on T014 is misleading if it implies T014 can run before T046/T060 complete. More critically, T014 depends on T006 (config.py) which is also [P]. The 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel', but T014 (Phase 2) is listed as dependent on Phase 1 tasks. The [P] tag on T014 is incorrect as it has hard dependencies on Phase 1 completion.

Task T045 (Schema Validation Test) is marked [P] with a note 'Execution Dependency: T014'. This is a semantic contradiction. A test task cannot be 'parallel-safe' if its execution is blocked by the completion of the implementation task (T014). The [P] tag implies it can run independently, but the description explicitly forbids this. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule where the test (consumer) cannot run before the implementation (producer) exists.

Task T015b (Ablation Data Generator) depends on T014 (Dialogue Generation) to produce the source tuples. However, T015b is marked [P]. This is a hard ordering violation: the ablation generator (consumer) cannot run in parallel with the dialogue generator (producer) because it requires the output of T014 as input. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect here.

Tasks T047a, T047b, T047c (Training runs) are marked [P]. However, T047b depends on T015b (Ablation) and T047c depends on T013 (Static). While the training scripts themselves might be independent of each other, the [P] tag on the group implies they can all start immediately after Phase 1. T047b and T047c cannot start until their respective data generation tasks (T015b, T013) complete. The parallel grouping is valid only if the data generation is complete, but the task list does not clearly separate the 'Data Ready' checkpoint from the 'Training Start' checkpoint.

Task T070-T074 (Review Alignment) are marked [P] and listed as Phase 5. However, T070 depends on T014 (Generation) and T072/T073 depend on T047a-c (Training) and T033 (Stats). The [P] tag suggests they can run in parallel with other Phase 5 tasks, but they have hard dependencies on Phase 2, 3, and 4 completion. The 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'Different user stories can be worked on in parallel', but Phase 5 tasks are cross-cutting and depend on the completion of US1, US2, and US3. The [P] tag is misleading without a clear 'Wait for US1/2/3' gate.
